title: RNA sequencing of human primary MKs in the presence or absence of AVP
description: CD34+ cells isolated from human cord blood were cultured with thrombopoietin for 10 days. Then, the cells were collected and purified for megakaryocytes (MKs) following stimulation with or without AVP for 4 days. MKs were finally harvested to explore the differentially expressed genes by RNA-seq.
